people.line: Daughter of Zelophehad, of the tribe of Manasseh.

people.name: Mahlah
people.line: Daughter of Zelophehad, who received an inheritance among her brothers.

people.name: Milcah
people.line: Daughter of Zelophehad, a descendant of Manasseh.

people.name: Tirzah
people.line: Daughter of Zelophehad, granted inheritance rights

people.name: Zelophehad
people.line: Israelite whose daughters received his inheritance

translations.web: for Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to their father’s brothers’ sons.
translations.bsb: Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to cousins on their father’s side.
translations.kjv: For Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their father's brothers' sons:
